str.description: Direct per-allele model (LightGBM): calibrated error probability P(|EH length - TRGT AL| > max(1 RU, 0.5 x AL)) and corrected long-read length (median, 80% interval); HPRC 274, autosomal and chrX loci; 42 features from the VCF record incl. partner allele

sv.description: LightGBM SV model: calibrated P(Manta DEL/INS/DUP call is discordant with the 2-of-3 long-read consensus); HPRC 274, calls of 50 bp - 5 Mb on autosomes and chrX; 33 features from the VCF record, reference sequence and annotation BEDs

str.model: direct per-allele model: LightGBM binary classifier (error probability, global isotonic calibration) + three LightGBM quantile regressors (corrected length); 42 features incl. partner allele; one hyperparameter set (num_leaves 127, min_data_in_leaf 1000, lr 0.05, early stopping)
str.truth: TRGT 5.1.0 allele span (AL, bp) at the same catalog loci
str.training_data: HPRC, 274 genomes with matched Illumina and PacBio HiFi data; ExpansionHunter 5.0.0 (Illumina extended catalog) and TRGT run with the sex of each genome
str.scope: autosomes and chrX; chrY/chrM records are kept but not scored; a haploid call is scored as a homozygous call

endpoints.error_probability: ASES/ASEL = calibrated P(|EH length − long-read length| > max(1 RU, 0.5 × long-read length)); tolerance fixed at training
endpoints.corrected_length: ASLS/ASLL = predicted long-read length bp: median, lo80, hi80 (quantiles 0.5 / 0.1 / 0.9 of log2 ratio)

sv.model: LightGBM binary classifier (error probability, global isotonic calibration); 33 features; num_leaves 127, min_data_in_leaf 1000, lr 0.05, early stopping
sv.truth: 2-of-3 consensus of Sniffles2, cuteSV and Sawfish on PacBio HiFi (Truvari collapse, reference distance 500 bp, size and sequence similarity 0.7, same type, events up to 5 Mb), HPRC 274 genomes
sv.labels: Truvari 5.3.0 bench per sample: refdist 500, pctsize 0.7, pctseq 0.7, pctovl 0, sizemin/sizefilt 50, sizemax 5 Mb, dup-to-ins, no-roll, pick single; discordant (FP) = 1
sv.scope: Manta DEL/INS/DUP calls of 50 bp - 5 Mb on autosomes and chrX; INV/BND, chrY/chrM and other sizes are not scored

endpoints.error_probability: ASEP (VCF FORMAT) / error_probability (TSV) = calibrated P(call is discordant with the long-read 2-of-3 consensus)

release.canonical_direction: higher error probability means greater endpoint-specific error risk
